name: The Sunken Aqueducts of Oakhaven
subtitle: Cell (-1, 0, 0) · Moss-Draped Viaducts & Silicate Cisterns
summary: Vast flooded multi-tiered limestone aqueducts reclaimed by luminous emerald ferns, spanning hydraulic turbine basins, western cistern ruins, and the Flooded Siphon Catacombs.

soundtrack.title: Hymn of the Emerald Sluice
soundtrack.composerNote: Lydian pastoral 4/4 suite: sparkling harp cascades, breathy flute phrasing, and shimmering modal water chimes.

dungeonEntrances.name: The Flooded Siphon Catacombs
dungeonEntrances.subtitle: Tier II Hydraulic Labyrinth · Beneath Crown Cistern

npcs.name: Lock-Keeper Maren Holt
npcs.title: Chief Hydraulic Engineer
npcs.greeting: Step lightly across the mossy sluice, Waywright. The Crown Cistern dropped four palms overnight—and the Flooded Siphon Catacombs north of the keep have begun vibrating.
npcs.cognitiveDrive: Maintain clean artesian head pressure across Oakhaven without draining the fern terraces.
npcs.concealedSecret: She diverted a hidden siphon toward the dry eastern villages against Citadel toll decrees.
npcs.speechCadence: Calm, practical, measured in water levels and masonry joints.
beliefs: Water belongs to the watershed before any charter tax.
Moss binds mortar longer than iron clamps if kept wet.

choices.label: Where is the aqueduct losing head pressure?
choices.reply: Sound the Sunken Sluice Arch on the bridge with your Bell-Hammer, then explore the Siphon Catacombs northwest of the Crown Cistern.
choices.thought: Checking whether the Waywright notices the eastern overflow diversion.

choices.label: Why does the fern moss glow emerald after dusk?
choices.reply: Dissolved feldspar from the upper watershed feeds its spores. Harvest nodules along the Fern Terrace and our mortar seals underwater.
choices.thought: Hoping this Waywright values ecological repair over salvage tolls.

npcs.name: Sluice-Wright Haldor
npcs.title: Turbine Brass-Turner
npcs.greeting: Hear that rhythmic clack? A limestone wedge jammed the Silt-Wheel bronze impeller. Strike the Spillway Bell once you scatter the Shardcasters.
npcs.cognitiveDrive: Keep Oakhaven grain mills turning cleanly on spring melt.
npcs.concealedSecret: He smelts salvaged aqueduct coins into corrosion-proof bearings.
npcs.speechCadence: Brisk workshop cadence, taps rhythmically on bronze calipers.
beliefs: A balanced wheel outlives three kings.

choices.label: I will calibrate the Silt-Wheel and strike the Spillway Bell.
choices.reply: Fine work! Strike true at 174 Hz so the sluice valves seat flush.
choices.thought: Quietly tucking away his tray of shaved bronze mintings.

quests.title: The Sunken Sluice of Oakhaven
quests.summary: Inspect Oakhaven’s flooded aqueduct piers, sound the Sunken Sluice Arch, and attune the Crown Cistern Waystone.

quests.title: Spore-Lime of the Fern Terrace
quests.summary: Gather aquatic silicate moss nodules along the Emerald Fern Terrace and drive off Fen Stalkers threatening the outer reservoir.
